draft.text:
You stand before the stone throne, your heart hammering against your ribs. The air is thick with the scent of cold dust and old iron. A silence hangs over the chamber, broken only by the distant, rhythmic beating of a massive clock in the tower above.

"Agree?" The voice that speaks is not the Warden's, but a voice belonging to an old man who sits in the shadows at your left side. He looks up from his satchel of tools, peering at you with eyes that seem to have seen too much. "I am not here to sell you dreams, traveler. The agreement is already inked and sealed."

He gestures vaguely toward the high throne where a massive, hooded figure sits, barely moving, staring at something beyond your view. "My master believes he has secured a servant for eternity. A bargain struck in blood, perhaps? Or maybe just a foolish promise made by someone drunk on power." He tilts his head, looking at you with genuine interest. "Did you know the Warden is currently... calculating?"

The old man continues, lowering his voice. "He's not doing much else these days. Not that it matters. You're standing in the way of whatever conclusion he reaches. What will you do when the calculation finishes? Will you run? Or will you try to find a loophole in a contract you didn't write?"
